verdict.rationale: Orama documents a programmatic surface: the open-source JS library API (create, insert/insertMultiple, faceted search) and official Cloud SDKs for JavaScript/TypeScript, Python and Rust. However, its own docs say the Cloud REST APIs are private and limited to authorized users, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: a publicly accessible REST API, a published OpenAPI/interactive reference, versioning policy, independent hands-on corroboration.
